# AI Disclosure

This document lists files in this repository that were created or modified with AI assistance and the approximate degree of AI involvement in each.

"Degree of involvement" is an estimate of how much of the file's content was generated by AI tools, as opposed to written by hand.

## Teleport Deployment

Files added or changed to deploy Teleport (Helm chart `teleport-cluster`) with a script. AI tool: Claude Code.

| File                           | AI Involvement | Change                                      |
|--------------------------------|----------------|---------------------------------------------|
| `scripts/deploy_teleport.sh`   |       100%     | Added: installs local-path-provisioner and the Teleport Helm chart |
| `scripts/teleport-values.yaml` |       100%     | Added: chart values, adapted from `gitops/argocd-apps/teleport.yaml` in `anbor_demo_cd` (also AI-generated) |
| `scripts/run_all.sh`           |       100%     | Updated: added `deploy_teleport.sh` to the script list (rest of file unchanged) |
| `variables.tf`                 |       100%     | Updated: `instance_type` default `t3a.small` → `t3a.medium` (rest of file unchanged) |
| `AI_DISCLOSURE.md`             |       100%     | Added: this file                            |
